$comment: Logical architecture schema aligned with frozen W0 AsyncKeyBundle v1; exact wire keys are in spec/cddl/keys.cddl (ADR-0140).

AsyncKeyMaterial.subject_device_id: stable DeviceID selected from relationship-pinned AccountControlState/DeviceCredential state
AsyncKeyMaterial.generation: globally monotonic signed-prekey generation for this DeviceID + CryptoProfile across provider pools
AsyncKeyMaterial.signed_prekey_material: profile-defined authenticated public handshake material; rotation strictly raises generation
AsyncKeyMaterial.post_quantum_prekey_material: profile-defined PQ signed/last-resort public handshake material when applicable
AsyncKeyMaterial.provider_pool_id: provider-distinct consumable-pool identifier; never a rollback namespace
AsyncKeyMaterial.one_time_material: consumable items individually signed over DeviceID + profile + generation + provider_pool_id + kind + key_id + public_key
AsyncKeyMaterial.fallback_material: explicitly identified reusable fallback only when permitted by profile
AsyncKeyMaterial.authorization: validated by the fetcher against relationship-pinned trusted peer ACS -> committed DeviceCredential -> bundle signature; no ACS generation/hash is provider-visible

ProviderRule: Consumable one-time material is disjoint across independent provider pools; all pools for one DeviceID/CryptoProfile share the same signed-prekey generation namespace.

RecipientFreshnessState.merge: higher generation wins; equal generation with unequal core hash is a security conflict
